headlines.title: Stock markets plunge as Nasdaq erases 2026 gains
headlines.description: The surging stock market of 2026 wiped out gains for the year in the tech-heavy Nasdaq Composite while the S&P 500 and the Dow entered correction territory, meaning they have declined 10% from recent peaks. NBC News' Brian Cheung reports.

headlines.title: Trump threatens ‘tremendous’ penalties on companies that build data centers overseas
headlines.description: President Trump plans to restrict U.S. companies from building data centers overseas — another example of his embrace of AI infrastructure most people oppose.

headlines.title: California man found guilty of starting deadly Palisades Fire
headlines.description: A California jury found a man guilty of starting the devastating 2025 Palisades Fire in Los Angeles that displaced thousands of people and became the most destructive wildfire in Los Angeles city history. NBC News' Steve Patterson has the details.

headlines.title: FBI investigating potential breach of its crime database
headlines.description: The FBI is investigating an apparent breach of its National Crime Information Center, two people briefed on the matter told NBC News Friday.

headlines.title: Trump touts historic summit with Xi, Putin
headlines.description: President Trump touted his unprecedented trilateral summit with China’s President Xi and Russian President Putin in a marathon press conference. NBC News’ Monica Alba reports.

headlines.title: 2026 Rockefeller Center Christmas Tree Arrives in New York City
headlines.description: A magnificent Norway spruce has made its journey from West Edmeston, New York, to Rockefeller Center. The tree will undergo a glow-up ahead of the lighting ceremony on Dec. 2.

headlines.title: FBI investigating potential breach of its crime database
headlines.description: The FBI is investigating an apparent breach of its National Crime Information Center, two people briefed on the matter told NBC News Friday.

headlines.title: Trump formally ends minting of the penny after nearly 250 years of production
headlines.description: The U.S. Mint, which began producing the currency in 1793, has said it costs nearly 4 cents to make each penny.

headlines.title: Iraqi security forces deploy in Iran-backed militia stronghold
headlines.description: JURF AL-SAKHAR, Iraq — Iraqi security forces deployed in Jurf al-Sakhar, a stronghold of the Kataib Hezbollah armed group, on Friday under a deal that seeks to limit the reach of Iran’s most powerful Shi’ite militia ally in the country without provoking a confrontation.

headlines.title: Man found guilty of starting deadly Palisades Fire in Los Angeles
headlines.description: LOS ANGELES — Almost five months after a first trial ended in a mistrial, a jury found a man guilty of starting what would become the devastating 2025 Palisades Fire in Los Angeles that displaced thousands of people and became the most destructive wildfire in the city’s history.

headlines.title: Police investigating death of fan after altercation at Cowboys game
headlines.description: Police in Texas said they are investigating the death of a fan who died days after an altercation at a Cowboys game.

headlines.title: New cervical cancer guidance to favor HPV screening over traditional Pap tests
headlines.description: New cervical cancer guidance to recommend for the first time that women ages 30 to 65 be screened for HPV rather than with the traditional Pap test.
